reason: The reported coefficient reproduces (0.954, SE 0.226, N=1960) and stays at about 0.90-0.93 when pre-period productivity and other 2020 characteristics are added, but the report presents a single cross-sectional OLS as a causal 'positive effect' without discussing endogeneity, without addressing that the 2023 management rating (correlation 0.52 with training) may be a confounder or mediator, and without stating that training_hours is standardized (so the units are undefined).
